title: Preserve a draw ability's player target through card conversion
required_behavior: For a draw AbilityDSL with Target.Filter player, ToGameCard sets SpellEffect.SpellTargetType to game.TargetPlayer.
Untargeted draws and the existing target-opponent representation keep their current behavior.
The new cards test uses package cards and imports magic-backend/game.
The test must populate both libraries before asserting that a cast targeted at player 1 makes player 1 draw and leaves player 0 unchanged.
implementation_hint: Mirror the neighboring target-lifting branch: create the draw SpellEffect, then copy a non-empty ability.Target.Filter into SpellTargetType before returning it.
gates: gofmt -d backend/cards/converter.go backend/cards/draw_target_lifting_test.go produces no output
git diff --name-only contains only the allowed paths
on_failure: Return a receipt with the patch proposal, raw telemetry, gate output, and one bounded repair opportunity; never copy a failed proposal into a real worktree.
